claim_text: A general wellness goal alone does not establish a micronutrient deficiency or justify claims that a multivitamin prevents chronic disease; evidence varies by outcome and population.
health_goal_or_outcome: Prevent duplicate supplementation and unsupported wellness claims; support safe total-intake assessment.

population.other_context: Adults selecting general wellness without a diagnosed deficiency or specific indication.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Dietary and supplemental sources; verify exact product label and formulation.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Multivitamin/mineral Supplements fact sheet summarizes evidence and limitations for broad health outcomes.
limitations: Do not present a multivitamin as a substitute for diet or disease prevention care.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
